data.name: Tolarian Academy
data.oracle_text: {T}: Add {U} for each artifact you control.
data.flavor_text: The academy worked with time—until time ran out.

data.name: Mind Over Matter
data.oracle_text: Discard a card: You may tap or untap target artifact, creature, or land.
data.flavor_text:
Lyna turned to the figure beside her. "They're gone. What now?"
"As ever," said Urza, "we wait."

data.name: Time Spiral
data.oracle_text: Exile Time Spiral. Each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library, then draws seven cards. You untap up to six lands.

data.name: Windfall
data.oracle_text: Each player discards their hand, then draws cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
data.flavor_text: "Rich" is a relative term.

data.name: Stroke of Genius
data.oracle_text: Target player draws X cards.
data.flavor_text: "Every thought is a star illuminating the darkness. Inspiration comes from finding the constellations that link them."

data.name: Lotus Petal
data.oracle_text: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color.
data.flavor_text: "Hard to imagine," mused Hanna, stroking the petal, "such a lovely flower inspiring such greed."

data.name: Mana Vault
data.oracle_text:
This artifact doesn't untap during your untap step.
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may pay {4}. If you do, untap this artifact.
At the beginning of your draw step, if this artifact is tapped, it deals 1 damage to you.
{T}: Add {C}{C}{C}.

data.name: Mox Diamond
data.oracle_text:
If this artifact would enter, you may discard a land card instead. If you do, put this artifact onto the battlefield. If you don't, put it into its owner's graveyard.
{T}: Add one mana of any color.

data.name: Voltaic Key
data.oracle_text: {1}, {T}: Untap target artifact.
data.flavor_text: The missing piece to every puzzle.

data.name: Turnabout
data.oracle_text: Choose artifact, creature, or land. Tap all untapped permanents of the chosen type target player controls, or untap all tapped permanents of that type that player controls.
data.flavor_text: The best cure for a big ego is a little failure.

data.name: Intuition
data.oracle_text: Search your library for three cards and reveal them. Target opponent chooses one. Put that card into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. Then shuffle.

data.name: Scroll Rack
data.oracle_text: {1}, {T}: Exile any number of cards from your hand face down. Put that many cards from the top of your library into your hand. Then look at the exiled cards and put them on top of your library in any order.

data.name: Ancient Tomb
data.oracle_text: {T}: Add {C}{C}. This land deals 2 damage to you.
data.flavor_text:
There is no glory to be gained in the kingdom of the dead.
—Vec tomb inscription

data.name: City of Brass
data.oracle_text:
Whenever this land becomes tapped, it deals 1 damage to you.
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
data.flavor_text: It's like the future's a party that these brothers just crashed . . .

data.name: Island
data.flavor_text:
"The Dream Dimension. A benevolent fountain of ideals, the source of humanity's collective inspiration, and the home of the muses themselves. Its wonder never ceases to amaze me."
—Doctor Strange

data.name: Lotus Field
data.oracle_text:
Hexproof
This land enters tapped.
When this land enters, sacrifice two lands.
{T}: Add three mana of any one color.

data.name: Thespian's Stage
data.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{2}, {T}: This land becomes a copy of target land, except it has this ability.
data.flavor_text: Amid rumors of war, the third act of *The Absolution of the Guildpact* was quickly rewritten as a tragedy.

data.name: Yavimaya Coast
data.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add {G} or {U}. This land deals 1 damage to you.
data.flavor_text: As magnigoth trees expanded across the sea into Almaaz and New Argive, it became clear Yavimaya's borders were never confined by its coastline.

data.name: Botanical Sanctum
data.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped unless you control two or fewer other lands.
{T}: Add {G} or {U}.

data.name: Mana Confluence
data.oracle_text: {T}, Pay 1 life: Add one mana of any color.
data.flavor_text: Five rivers encircle Theros, flowing with waters more ancient than the world itself.

data.name: Boseiju, Who Endures
data.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {G}.
Channel — {1}{G}, Discard this card: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or nonbasic land an opponent controls. That player may search their library for a land card with a basic land type, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. This ability costs {1} less to activate for each legendary creature you control.

data.name: Forest
data.flavor_text:
"You have only one mission, minions: protect me with your lives. In order to do this, you need to wear down Captain Britain's psyche. In order to do *that*, you need to burn down her precious lands. Am I understood?"
—Morgan Le Fay

data.name: Hidden Strings
data.oracle_text:
You may tap or untap target permanent, then you may tap or untap another target permanent.
Cipher (Then you may exile this spell card encoded on a creature you control. Whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player, its controller may cast a copy of the encoded card without paying its mana cost.)

data.name: Pore Over the Pages
data.oracle_text: Draw three cards, untap up to two lands, then discard a card.
data.flavor_text: "'I'm certain that the fate of Markov Manor is connected to these cryptoliths . . .' This Tamiyo was on to something."

data.name: Sylvan Scrying
data.oracle_text: Search your library for a land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
data.flavor_text:
"As long as there is a single shred of life, there is hope."
—Nissa Revane

data.name: Vizier of Tumbling Sands
data.oracle_text:
{T}: Untap another target permanent.
Cycling {1}{U} ({1}{U}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)
When you cycle this card, untap target permanent.
data.flavor_text: "Time is like the Luxa River—though it flows in one direction, it can be diverted."

data.name: Arboreal Grazer
data.oracle_text:
Reach
When this creature enters, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
data.flavor_text:
"We fight to stop a tyrant, but we also fight for the gentle creatures who have no concept of what befalls their world."
—Vivien Reid

data.name: Emergent Ultimatum
data.oracle_text: Search your library for up to three monocolored cards with different names and exile them. An opponent chooses one of those cards. Shuffle that card into your library. You may cast the other cards without paying their mana costs. Exile Emergent Ultimatum.

data.name: Omniscience
data.oracle_text: You may cast spells from your hand without paying their mana costs.
data.flavor_text:
"The things I once imagined would be my greatest achievements were only the first steps toward a future I can only begin to fathom."
—Jace Beleren

data.name: Dark Petition
data.oracle_text:
Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle.
Spell mastery — If there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, add {B}{B}{B}.

data.name: Mastermind's Acquisition
data.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
• Put a card you own from outside the game into your hand.
data.flavor_text: Another piece of a nefarious puzzle.

data.name: Peer into the Abyss
data.oracle_text: Target player draws cards equal to half the number of cards in their library and loses half their life. Round up each time.
data.flavor_text:
"Oh, don't be so dramatic. When your eyes bleed, and your brain leaks out your ears, then we'll talk about lost sanity."
—Braids, dementia summoner

data.name: Approach of the Second Sun
data.oracle_text: If this spell was cast from your hand and you've cast another spell named Approach of the Second Sun this game, you win the game. Otherwise, put Approach of the Second Sun into its owner's library seventh from the top and you gain 7 life.

data.name: Lier, Disciple of the Drowned
data.oracle_text:
Spells can't be countered.
Each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard has flashback. The flashback cost is equal to that card's mana cost.
data.flavor_text: Beneath the waves, lost gods stir in their slumber.
